tools.name: limecrm_list_limetypes
tools.description: List the limetypes (object types) of this Lime CRM application with their properties. Call this first to learn the names for the other tools. Lime API: GET /api/v1/limetype/.

tools.name: limecrm_get_limetype
tools.description: Get the definition of one limetype (its name and properties). Lime API: GET /api/v1/limetype/{limetype}/.

tools.name: limecrm_get_limeobject
tools.description: Get one object of a limetype by id, with its field values. Lime API: GET /api/v1/limeobject/{limetype}/{id}/.

tools.name: limecrm_query_limeobjects
tools.description: Find objects of one limetype, returning the listed fields, with an optional filter on one property and paging. Lime Query API: GET /api/v1/query/?q=<json>.

tools.name: limecrm_list_users
tools.description: List the users of this Lime CRM application, optionally only active ones or one user type. Lime API: GET /api/v1/admin/users/. Your API user needs admin rights to read users.

tools.name: limecrm_create_limeobject
tools.description: Create one object of a limetype with the field values you pass. This writes to the customer's CRM and this server has no tool to delete or undo it. Lime API: POST /api/v1/limeobject/{limetype}/.
